body: Confirmed optional corvint-test-runner reader bug at immutable05d66c36abf3f8c051ce12fa83670a728a98b770, unchanged CLI source in published1e71d5f5. Private original-source Go1.27.1 binary SHA c31d0631678898a395c7790d545eb8a625f36c8fed606bbd978c0f04eda33e49: plan --request FIFO_0600_no_writer with syntactically valid independent executable flags blocks before document validation, remains blocked after actual SIGINT because signal context cannot interrupt os.Open; direct owned child was killed/reaped and FIFO removed. No native runner launched. Actual evidence /private/tmp/cem10-build/stable-next/gradle-isolated-profile-proposal/fifo-reproduction/reproduction.json SHAc036cfb3075fd1d156a415a7ba852f93a9ca6aba824d96b154d374a39670ea51. CLI read helper opens before f.Stat; new private Gradle checkGradleToolchain opens manifest before any regular-file check and before execution timeout. Expected bounded special-file refusal, actual blocking admission. FIFO/runner document native searches found related index FIFO issue0388 and provider investigation0562 but no runner reader duplicate. Gradle profile source integration remains experimental/partial and this repair does not grant SDK retirement or hostile filesystem authority.
